repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvVRcFWKrfWeG5jzPb

Carry-over from PR #35748 (#35481), contract review 7031584838 §③, for whoever claims this card (2026-11-20T05:44Z):

Skills-docs: when the relationship-path drill gets its list-URL spelling, the three sentences PR #35748 adds come out with it: the bullet "Today a relationship-path dimension (`account.industry`) gets the drawer only, no link." in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` (Drilldown, Escape hatch), the relationship-path sentence in the Drill-down paragraph of `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx`, and the "except today on a relationship-path dimension" clause in that page's renderer note. Replace them with the general rule stated once (the link is offered only when the list URL can write the whole drill filter exactly; `$or`, `$between`, a null or Date comparand, two comparands on one field and an unreadable field still get none, per `useOpenRecordList.ts:86`), as `content/docs/releases/v18/18-4.mdx:620` already publishes. The skill file sits at its token ceiling, so the replacement is paid inside the same bullet.

Stale docblocks on the same path (comment-only, read on `main` `ca4ec2a2`): `resolveRelationshipDrill` (`ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx:884`), the drill comment at `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx:1335`, and the `notice` doc of `DrillDownDrawer.tsx` still describe reading related ids and an `$in` filter. Fix them in the same PR.

Also measure, once: a date-bucketed dimension on a relationship path is sent as a range keyed by the dotted `field` (`analytics-service.ts:3462`, `:3555`; `buildDatasetDrillFilter`, `dataset-format.ts:762`); what the drawer and the list-link gate do with that dotted range key was read, not measured. A defect there is a code finding for this card, not a wording change.
